title: A closing quote on its own line needs the indentation of the scalar's continuation lines
notes: The value of `a` is in a block mapping at indentation 0, so every line after the first break starts with a flow line prefix of at least 1 space (production 69), and that includes the line that holds nothing but the closing quote (production 115 ends a scalar after a break and its prefix). A quote at column 1 is not allowed, so the quote is the first character that cannot belong: line 2, column 1. A continuation line with text, `a: "x\ny"`, is refused the same way (compare yaml-test-suite DK95/01).

provenance.reference: A reader that checked the indentation of continuation lines but not of the line with the closing quote, and read the input as `{a: "x ", b: 1}`.
